en.app.title: TRAILDASH
en.app.tagline: THE CITY ENDS. YOUR TRAIL DOESN’T.
en.menu.description:
Find your line above the clouds.
Dodge the cargo. Chase the light.
en.menu.footer: OFFLINE  ·  NO ADS  ·  JUST ONE MORE RUN
en.tutorial.title: FIND YOUR FLOW
en.tutorial.body:
Swipe left / right to switch lanes.
Swipe up to jump coral cargo.
Swipe down to slide under mint gates.
Go around tall garden pylons.

Follow amber rings for tokens.
One lane is always open.
Collect in a row to build a 4× combo.
en.tutorial.keyboard:
Keyboard: arrows or WASD · Space jumps
P / Esc pauses · Touch buttons work too
en.pause.title: TAKE A BREATHER
en.pause.body: Your trail is right where you left it.
en.hud.hint: SWIPE TO MOVE  ·  FOLLOW THE LIGHT
en.results.title: NICE TRAIL.
en.results.subtitle: Catch your breath. Find a new line.
en.results.stats:
{distance} m traveled   ·   {tokens} tokens
{combo} best streak   ·   {seconds} seconds
en.settings.title: YOUR KIND OF RUN
en.settings.privacy:
Everything stays on this device.
No accounts, ads, tracking or network access.
en.colors.title: MAKE YOUR MARK
en.colors.body:
A fresh color. Same fast feet.
New colors cost 60 earned tokens.
en.controls.title: Keyboard controls
en.controls.body:
Choose an action, then press a key.
Arrows and Space remain available. P / Esc pauses.
en.controls.waiting:
Press a new key for {action}.
Arrows, Space, P and Escape are reserved.
